source: All panels: same autonomous spatial rate DDE. Equilibrium / periodic BVP; no SNN trajectories or startup transients.
branch_lines: Colored lines give converged periodic mean (thick) and min/max (thin); stability coverage is separate.
LPC_markers: Open squares: BVP-located folds; filled squares: independent full-state mode checks accepted in cycle_fold_evidence_inventory.json. Neither symbol establishes adjacent orbit stability.
PD_markers: Filled triangles: validated PD roots; open triangles with question marks: previously located roots requiring temporal-resolution repair. Withheld child geometry is not an accepted state example.
readout: Contact-weighted firing-rate envelope, not electrical SEEG voltage.
field_scale: Shared across all cases; low-rate fields appear dark.
